title: A Reverse-Gold Theorem: Positive-Data Identification by Substrate-Bounded Contrastive Learners
abstract: arXiv:2610.28747v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gold's theorem shows that no learner can identify an arbitrary language in a superfinite class from positive presentations alone. We prove a positive result of a different shape. Fix an innate \emph{recursive contrast operator} $R$ mapping any string to a finite set of structurally bounded perturbations of it, and a discriminative scorer of bounded capacity trained by InfoNCE-style contrastive estimation \citep{vandenoord2018,macollins2018} on self-generated perturbations. Under a faithfulness condition relating operator, scorer, and target, the trained scorer achieves \emph{PAC conditional identification} from positive data alone: with high probability it ranks all but an $\varepsilon$-fraction of positives above every out-of-language perturbation in their own orbit, with sample complexity polynomial in the capacity, the orbit size, the score bound, and $1/\varepsilon$. translated_title: 逆向戈德定理：基于基底受限对比学习器的正数据语言识别
translated_abstract: 戈德定理表明，任何学习器都无法仅凭正例呈现来识别超有限类中的任意语言。我们证明了一个形态不同的正面结果。固定一个先天的“递归对比算子”$R$，它将任意字符串映射到其结构上受限的有限扰动集合；再考虑一个容量受限的判别式评分器，它通过在自我生成的扰动上进行InfoNCE式对比估计训练。在算子、评分器与目标语言之间满足忠实性条件的前提下，训练后的评分器能够仅凭正数据实现“PAC条件识别”：以高概率，它会把除$\varepsilon$比例之外的所有正例都排在其自身轨道中每个语言外扰动之上，且样本复杂度关于模型容量、轨道大小、分数界限和$1/\varepsilon$呈多项式级。负例由学习器自行构造，而非由外部提供……
tldr: 该论文证明了一个“逆向戈德定理”：借助先天递归对比算子自我生成结构受限的负例扰动，并以InfoNCE式对比学习训练的受限评分器，在忠实性条件下可仅凭正数据实现高概率的PAC条件语言识别，且样本复杂度仅为多项式级。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a "Reverse-Gold theorem": a bounded-capacity scorer trained via InfoNCE-style contrastive learning on perturbations self-generated by an innate recursive contrast operator can, under a faithfulness condition, achieve PAC conditional identification of a target language from positive data alone, with polynomial sample complexity.
